base_prompt: Hand-painted romantic 19th-century oil painting on canvas with the fine linework of a steel engraving, as in an illustrated 1850s edition of Goethe's Faust (in the spirit of Delacroix's Faust lithographs and Caspar David Friedrich). Clearly painted, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT digital concept art: visible loose brushstrokes, subtle engraved cross-hatching in the shadows, slightly aged varnish. Muted earthy palette of umber, ochre, slate blue and ivory with restrained deep crimson accents. Soft chiaroscuro, single warm key light from the upper left. Semi-realistic proportions. No text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border.

templates.background: Visual novel background, 16:9 wide establishing shot at eye level, empty foreground band in the bottom third, no people unless described.
templates.sprite: Visual novel character sprite, 2:3 portrait. One character, standing, framed from head to knees, centred, body turned slightly toward the viewer, whole head and both hands inside the frame with clear margin above the head. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform chroma-green (#00B140) field with no gradient, no floor, no shadow and no props. No green anywhere on the character.
templates.variant: Use the reference image: keep exactly the same character, face, hair, costume, framing, scale, lighting and flat chroma-green (#00B140) background. Change only the facial expression and pose of the hands as described.

assets.prompt: Twilight sky of drifting silver mist; faint translucent human figures half-formed in the clouds, like memories, with no recognisable faces; melancholic and dreamlike.

The empty wooden stage of a small late-18th-century German theatre seen from the wings toward the stage: painted canvas flats, a heavy curtain partly drawn, a row of candle footlights, rehearsal daylight falling from high windows, dust in the air.

The celestial realm high above luminous clouds, the sun blazing and stars visible in a deep blue sky; three robed, winged archangels in white and gold, small and distant in the middle ground, singing.

The celestial realm above luminous clouds; at the centre a throne-shaped radiance of golden light with no visible figure inside it, rays spreading outward; the heavenly hosts as faint winged silhouettes on both sides.

A narrow, high-vaulted Gothic study at night: shelves crammed with old books and parchments, alembics and glass vessels, a skull, dusty instruments; an oil lamp burning on a heavy wooden desk with a great open book; cold moonlight through a tall leaded-glass window on the left mixing with the warm lamplight.
assets.notes: Calibration image: composition good but too photorealistic; base prompt tightened.
